summary: The StaffManualPlacements module manages the manual creation, update, search, and deletion of staff placement records. It defines the data structure, validation logic, and business rules for placement operations, and interacts with the database via stored procedures.
purpose: To allow authorized users to manually add, update, search, and delete staff placement records in the system, ensuring data integrity and adherence to validation and business requirements.
actors: HSPnetSession (system/actor handling session, validation, and DB calls)

workflows.name: Add Staff Manual Placement
steps: Set field values (StaffID, ProgramID, RcvAgencyID, SiteID, ServiceID, DestinationID, CourseShortName, PlacementTypeID, StartDateFormatted, EndDateFormatted, DurationHoursFormatted, GroupSizeFormatted, InstructorLastName, InstructorFirstName).
Add parameters for all fields to Sess.DB.

workflows.name: Update Staff Manual Placement
steps: Set relevant field values (ProgramID, RcvAgencyID, SiteID, ServiceID, DestinationID, CourseShortName, PlacementTypeID, StartDateFormatted, EndDateFormatted, DurationHoursFormatted, GroupSizeFormatted, InstructorLastName, InstructorFirstName).
Add parameters for all fields and PlacementID to Sess.DB.

workflows.name: Delete Staff Manual Placement
steps: Add SessionID and PlacementID as parameters.

workflows.name: Search Staff Manual Placements
steps: Iterate results, fill StaffManualPlacement objects, return list.

workflows.name: Search Staff Manual Placement by ID
steps: Retrieve data and fill StaffManualPlacement objects.

business_rules: DurationHours must be a valid integer.
GroupSize must be a valid integer.
validations: ProgramID required (error: Program must be entered).
RcvAgencyID required (error: Agency must be specified).
DurationHours must be a valid integer (error: Hours must be a valid integer).
GroupSize must be a valid integer (error: Students must be a valid integer).
calculations: DurationHoursFormatted returns '' if DurationHours == -1, else formatted string.
GroupSizeFormatted is the string representation of GroupSize.
conditions: Only add/update/delete if IsValid returns true.
Only delete/search by ID if ID > 0.
system_behavior: Uses stored procedures for database operations.
Validates input fields before performing add/update operations.
Returns appropriate error messages for validation failures.
Fills StaffManualPlacement objects from database query results.
exceptions: Validation failures halt workflow and return error messages.
Invalid or empty IDs prevent delete/search operations.
content_gaps: No UI/UX workflow or error handling beyond DB and validation logic.
No details on concurrency, locking, or performance.
No information about historical recording or audit trails.
